description: Implementation of the WMLMap class for the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, managing map data including terrain, units, import/export, and resizing.

classes.name: WMLMap
classes.description: Represents a map in the Wesnoth Scenario Editor, handling map data, resizing, importing/exporting, and unit placement.

methods.name: initWithSize:by:
methods.description: Initializes the map with specified width and height, filling with grass terrain.

methods.name: dealloc
methods.description: Releases map data resources.

methods.name: encodeWithCoder:
methods.description: Encodes map data for serialization.

methods.name: initWithCoder:
methods.description: Decodes map data from serialized form.

methods.name: setWidth:
methods.description: Resizes the map to a new width.

methods.name: setHeight:
methods.description: Resizes the map to a new height.

methods.name: resizeTo:by:
methods.description: Resizes the map to specified dimensions, maintaining or filling with default terrain.

methods.name: getRow:
methods.description: Returns a specific row of map points.

methods.name: getWidth
methods.description: Returns the current width of the map.

methods.name: getHeight
methods.description: Returns the current height of the map.

methods.name: setPointToTerrain:x:y:
methods.description: Sets a specific point's terrain type.

methods.name: setPointToUnit:type:side:x:y:
methods.description: Places a unit at a specific map point.

methods.name: clearUnitAtPointX:y:
methods.description: Removes units from a specific map point.

methods.name: updateMapPointUnitsWith:
methods.description: Updates units on the map based on a lookup array.

methods.name: exportToFile:
methods.description: Exports the map to a file.

methods.name: exportToString
methods.description: Exports the map to a string representation.

methods.name: importFromFile:
methods.description: Imports map data from a file.

methods.name: updateUnitsWithLookup:
methods.description: Updates units on the map with a lookup array.

methods.name: getUnitListForDifficulty:forSide:
methods.description: Generates a list of units for a specific difficulty and side.

methods.name: getMapPointAtX:Y:
methods.description: Returns the map point at specified coordinates.

methods.name: iterateSelector:withObject:
methods.description: Applies a selector to all map points.
